programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Cycle Savages
programme.desc: A biker (Bruce Dern) and his gang go after an artist (Chris Robinson) for whom his girlfriend posed in the nude.

programme.title: The Savage Seven
programme.desc: A motorcycle gang terrorizes a Native American reservation -- until the gang's leader, Kisum (Adam Roarke), falls for waitress Marcia Little Hawk (Joanna Frank). The two groups soon put aside their differences to team up against crooked Fillmore (Mel Berger), who employs Marcia and her brother, Johnnie (Robert Walker). But Fillmore decides to encourage dissent among them, arranging for the death of a gang member and framing a Native American -- which leads Kisum to plot an attack on the town.

programme.title: Timbuktu
programme.desc: In French Sudan, the Tuareg people are rebelling against the colonists. Col. Dufort (George Dolenz), ordered to take command of the French troops in Timbuktu, Mali, arrives with his wife, Natalie (Yvonne De Carlo), in tow. Dufort's primary initiative is to see that a respected Tuareg religious leader makes it to the city for peace talks. When the holy man goes missing, Dufort hires American adventurer Mike Conway (Victor Mature) to track him down before the Tuareg uprising gets out of hand.

programme.title: Deadly Duo
programme.desc: An evil twin (Marcia Henderson) resorts to impersonation and attempted murder to get money due her sister.

programme.title: Hot Cars
programme.desc: A car salesman is framed for the murder of a police officer when he refuses to sell stolen vehicles for gangsters.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: Chino (Dennis Hopper) is the head of the Black Souls, a California motorcycle gang at odds with another crew, the Glory Stompers. One day, Chino and his fellow gang members kidnap the head of the Stompers, Darryl (Jody McCrea), and his girlfriend, Chris (Chris Noel). After a heavy beating, the cyclists abandon Darryl but take Chris with them to Mexico. While Chris faces threats of abuse, Darryl teams up with Smiley (Jock Mahoney), an aging ex-Stomper, for a final showdown with the Souls.

rating.system: Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: The Mini-Skirt Mob
programme.desc: The leader (Diane McBain) of a motorcycle gang harasses her ex-boyfriend and his bride (Sherry Jackson) on their highway honeymoon.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good.

programme.title: Angels From Hell
programme.desc: A veteran's homecoming includes acid trips, pot parties and easy women as well as his old role as leader of the pack.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Cycle Savages
programme.desc: A biker (Bruce Dern) and his gang go after an artist (Chris Robinson) for whom his girlfriend posed in the nude.

programme.title: Hannibal Brooks
programme.desc: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis.

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: War, Italian Style
programme.desc: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy.

programme.title: Dr. Goldfoot and the Girl Bombs
programme.desc: The scheming Dr. Goldfoot (Vincent Price) is determined to conquer the world yet again, this time by deploying a legion of explosive robots that happen to look like gorgeous women. Fortunately for the citizens of the globe, suave secret agent Bill Dexter (Fabian) is out to foil Goldfoot's plans, which involve kidnapping a prominent American general (also Price) who bears a striking resemblance to Goldfoot. Also getting in on the antics is inept aspiring spy Franco (Franco Franchi).

programme.title: The Devil's Disciple
programme.desc: When Dick Dudgeon (Kirk Douglas) learns his father was executed by the British for treason at the onset of the Revolutionary War, he steals the body for a proper burial after minister Anthony Anderson's (Burt Lancaster) pleas for it are in vain. While visiting with the minister and his wife, the British mistakenly arrest Dick, who says nothing, choosing to stand in the minister's place. Can Anderson and the rebels convince Gen. Burgoyne (Laurence Olivier) to free Dick before he's hanged?

programme.title: The Happy Thieves
programme.desc: An art thief (Rex Harrison), his lover (Rita Hayworth) and a forger (Joseph Wiseman) plot to steal a Goya painting from the Prado museum in Madrid.

programme.title: Crime of Passion
programme.desc: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals.

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: The son of Philip of Macedonia (Fredric March) and Olympias (Danielle Darrieux), Alexander the Great (Richard Burton) is one of the most legendary leaders throughout history. As the Macedonian king, Alexander successfully unites all the ancient Greek tribes and leads them to defeat the imposing Persian Empire. With the fall of Babylon, Alexander continues to conquer most of the known world. Eventually, he achieves the status of unparalleled ruler atop his newly formed Greek empire.

programme.desc: When Dick Dudgeon (Kirk Douglas) learns his father was executed by the British for treason at the onset of the Revolutionary War, he steals the body for a proper burial after minister Anthony Anderson's (Burt Lancaster) pleas for it are in vain. While visiting with the minister and his wife, the British mistakenly arrest Dick, who says nothing, choosing to stand in the minister's place. Can Anderson and the rebels convince Gen. Burgoyne (Laurence Olivier) to free Dick before he's hanged?

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

programme.title: Popi
programme.desc: Genial Puerto Rican widower Abraham Rodriguez, known as "Popi" to his preteen sons, grapples with poverty and hardship in their Spanish Harlem neighborhood. Desperate to provide his sons every opportunity to succeed, and noting the reverence with which Americans treat Cuban immigrants, Popi lights upon a wild scheme. He sets his boys afloat in a boat off the coast of Florida, confident that they will be "rescued" as Cuban refugees and adopted by wealthy patrons.

programme.title: Beach Party

Their relaxed lifestyle fascinates Professor Sutwell (Bob Cummings), an anthropologist who decides to study the social lives of teens. A series of beach-themed films would follow the blueprint set by this one, which hinges on romantic rivalries, rugged motorcyclists, an attempted crime and plenty of handsome people.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad
programme.desc: At the Elmview Corrective School for Girls, the facility's warden, Mr. Riggs (Cecil Clovelly), abuses prisoners and justifies his actions as strict discipline. Dr. John H. Jason (Paul Henreid), the school's head psychologist, and Ruth Levering (Catherine McLeod), an assistant, view Riggs' actions as unethical, and believe he's driving the prisoners further toward delinquency. They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: The Big Night

programme.title: Lost Lagoon
programme.desc: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. The stress gets so bad that Walker flees his responsibilities and takes to the open sea in his boat. A storm destroys the vessel, and he winds up stranded on a Caribbean island. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision.

programme.title: De Sade

Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Paul (Peter Fonda), a director saddened by his failed marriage and unsatisfied with his work, is looking to start over. His friend, the cool, sage-like John (Bruce Dern), suggests that an LSD trip is exactly what Paul needs to get out of his rut. Paul decides to indulge, and experiences visions that are alternately beautiful and terrifying. His hallucinations, which include a carnival populated by dwarfs, bizarrely erotic encounters and even his own death, radically reshape his consciousness.

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: Electra
programme.desc: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide?

Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton).

Reaching their target at Bikini Atoll, they find the area full of hostile enemies and helpful guerrillas, including the stunning Reiko (Eva Six), with whom Hayes develops a relationship during the mission.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: The Set Up
programme.desc: Charlie Thorpe is a brilliant security expert and convicted burglar. After being released from prison, Charlie resolves to turn his life around and takes a straight job designing the security for a newly renovated bank. However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Hot Cars
programme.desc: A car salesman is framed for the murder of a police officer when he refuses to sell stolen vehicles for gangsters.

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

programme.title: Love Is a Ball
programme.desc: Matchmaker Etienne Pimm (Charles Boyer) makes his living by pairing European aristocrats with rich Americans, and his latest match is between Duke Gaspard Ducluzeau (Ricardo Montalban) and affluent heiress Millie Mehaffey (Hope Lange). Unfortunately, Ducluzeau, handsome and titled as he is, needs some help in acting aristocratic. Luckily, John Davis (Glenn Ford) is on hand to teach the Duke how to behave like the high-society man he is, at least until Davis and Mehaffey meet.

programme.title: What's New, Pussycat?
programme.desc: An irrepressible cad by nature, Michael James (Peter O'Toole) is determined to reform and stay faithful to his fiancée, Carole (Romy Schneider). However, Michael's attempt at fidelity is jeopardized when numerous attractive women become smitten with him, including Liz (Paula Prentiss) and Rita (Ursula Andress). Meanwhile, another of Michael's admirers, Renée (Capucine), is the object of fixation for his therapist, the wacky Dr. Fritz Fassbender (Peter Sellers).

programme.title: Lord Love a Duck
programme.desc: An unusually gifted high school senior, Alan Musgrave (Roddy McDowall), decides to direct his mental powers toward helping an innocent new student, Barbara Ann Greene (Tuesday Weld), achieve her goal of popularity. With Alan's guidance, Barbara climbs the social ladder, finds a husband and eventually gets a shot at a glamorous movie career. But when Barbara's husband begins to get in the way of her ambitions, Alan will stop at nothing to make sure she reaches the top.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.title: Dance With Me Henry
programme.desc: Children help an amusement-park owner (Lou Costello) and his buddy (Bud Abbott) get out of trouble with gangsters.

programme.title: Sinful Davey
programme.desc: Though his father received a death sentence for thievery, Davey Haggart (John Hurt) nevertheless wants to be a criminal too. He quits the military and starts carrying out small-time robberies. His pal Annie (Pamela Franklin) wants him to quit the criminal life, but she grudgingly helps him avoid law enforcement. Finally, though, Constable Richardson (Nigel Davenport) catches up with Davey, who will be hanged unless Annie and a fellow thief named MacNab (Ronald Fraser) can stop his execution.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
programme.desc: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

programme.title: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
programme.desc: Frustrated that he still hasn't lost his virginity, teenage grocery store delivery boy Jamie McGregor (Barry Evans) appeals to Spike (Christopher Timothy), an older ladies' man, for advice. After failing to seal the deal with several local girls because of his working class mannerisms and a paralyzing case of teenage self-doubt, Jamie struggles to get the attention of Mary Gloucester (Judy Geeson), a beautiful classmate who doesn't seem to know he even exists.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: The Wild Pair
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on.

programme.title: Rappin'
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mario Van Peebles) shows residents of his Pittsburgh ghetto how to drive out riffraff with rap music.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: Disappointed with her small part in the chorus line of a Los Angeles show, jazz dancer Kelly (Lucinda Dickey) quits and heads home. Her father (John Christy Ewing) disapproves of Kelly's friendship with street dancers Ozone (Adolfo "Shabba-Doo" Quinones) and Turbo (Michael "Boogaloo Shrimp" Chambers), and encourages her to pursue an opportunity to perform in Paris. Ignoring his wishes, Kelly teams up with her friends for a break-dancing benefit show to save an endangered community center.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Cooley High

They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Gun Belt
programme.desc: After giving up his gunfighting ways, Billy Ringo (George Montgomery) has settled down with his new wife, Arlene (Helen Westcott), on a ranch he's just purchased with his brother, Matt (John Dehner), and nephew Chip (Tab Hunter). But when Matt tricks him into participating in a bank robbery -- and frames him as the ringleader -- Billy is forced to go on the run from lawman Wyatt Earp (James Millican), and once again take up his guns against his former rival, Ike Clinton (William Bishop).

programme.title: Noose for a Gunman
programme.desc: Gunslinger Case Britton (Jim Davis) isn't welcome in his hometown of Rock Valley. He's still wanted for the murder of the Avery brothers, the sons of local tycoon Carl Avery (Barton MacLane). He's forced back into Rock Valley, however, because he's received word that outlaw Jack Cantrell (Ted de Corsia) plans on robbing a stagecoach that is coming into town. As Case struggles to earn the trust of the locals, he begins to suspect that Avery may have something to do with the planned robbery.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: The Ride Back
programme.desc: Determined to redeem his life as a failure, Sheriff Chris Hamish crosses the Mexican border to find an outlaw named Kallen and extradite him to Texas for a fair trial. Hamish arrests Kallen, who doubts the sheriff's ability to bring him to justice and makes several attempts to escape. But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Recognizing that Maj. Robert Parrish (Dale Robertson) has a history of making peace with Native American tribes, President Ulysses S. Grant (John Hamilton) sends him to iron out a land dispute with Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish). Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in.

programme.title: Westward Bound
programme.desc: Corrupt politician Albert Lane (Weldon Heyburn), town councilor Roger Caldwell (Harry Woods) and tax agent Henry Wagner (Karl Hackett) plot to steal the land of Montana ranchers. The ranchers, led by feisty Jasper Tuttle (Hal Price) and Enid Barrett (Betty Miles), band together to fight back. With the help of a trio of virtuous U.S. marshals called the Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele), the honest ranchers tangle with the politicians' henchmen.

programme.title: The Dalton Girls
programme.desc: After the criminal Dalton brothers are slain, two of the brothers' eldest daughters, Holly and Rose, get into an altercation with an undertaker and are forced to kill him. On the run from Detective Hiram Parsh, who pursued the Dalton brothers for years, Holly and Rose take assumed names and begin a life of petty crime in order to get money to send their younger sisters, Columbine and Marigold, to school in the East.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Gun Duel in Durango

When he rejects the demand to rejoin their ranks, these cruel crooks promptly use their next heist to frame the innocent Sabre. To save his reputation and future, he must set out to capture his former cohorts -- with the law in hot pursuit.

programme.title: The Iroquois Trail

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

Joe Dirt (David Spade) is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream -- to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was eight. But as Joe's story unfolds, jeers turn to cheers, and an entire city is captivated.

Though the school nurse (Salma Hayek) thinks he's crazy, Scott gains something he never expected, and the school rallies behind him.

programme.desc: Former "Extra" correspondent Jon Kelley hosts this comedy game show that features a panel of comedians interacting with two contestants, who have a chance to win cash if they can read between the lines of the comics' jokes. programme.title: Doc
programme.desc: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.

Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. Contributors include Stephen Fry, Ben Elton, Greg Davies, Paul Jackson, John Lloyd, Nigel Planer and Adrian Edmondson.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: A mutated virus sweeps across America, turning most of the population into hideous flesh-eating zombies. A hard-drinking fearless adventurer leads a small band of young survivors on a perilous journey through the wasteland in search of a safe haven. Comedy horror, with Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone and Abigail Breslin.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five students staying in a remote cabin find an ancient magical book, and unwittingly unleash evil spirits on the world. The dark forces they have conjured up possess them one by one, transforming them into ravenous zombies with an insatiable desire to feast on the living. Sam Raimi's horror, starring Bruce Campbell and Ellen Sandweiss.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Hapless Ash takes his girlfriend to a remote cabin in the woods, only for her to be killed and possessed by evil spirits. As a motley group of strangers turns up, they too find themselves under attack from demonic entities, leaving Ash the task of fending off the forces of darkness with his trusty chainsaw. Sam Raimi's comedy horror sequel, starring Bruce Campbell and Sarah Berry.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Massachusetts doctor Louis Creed moves to a small Maine town with his wife Rachel, their kids, Ellie and Gage, and Church, the cat. While exploring the local woods, Ellie stumbles across a funeral procession of children taking a dead dog to a cemetery. Neighbour Jud Crandall warns the Creeds that the woods are dangerous, as they soon discover for themselves via the dark power of the local burial ground. Horror based on the Stephen King novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: A palaeontologist, a game warden, a conspiracy theorist and a redneck sheriff each set out to investigate a mysterious death on the shore of a lake, only to find themselves up against a man-eating 30ft crocodile with an insatiable appetite. Comedy horror, starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda, Oliver Platt, Brendan Gleeson and Betty White.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson.

programme.title: Wolf Man
programme.desc: After a family barricade themselves inside their remote farmhouse when a creature attacks, a father slowly transforms into something unrecognisable. Werewolf horror from The Invisible Man director Leigh Whannell, starring Christopher Abbott, Julia Garner, Matilda Firth and Sam Jaeger.

programme.title: It Feeds
programme.desc: After a young girl bursts into their home psychiatry practice claiming an entity is feeding on her, Jordan and her clairvoyant mother must find a way to stop the evil. Horror, starring Shawn Ashmore and Ashley Greene.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Film-makers venture deep into the Amazon jungle to document the lives of a remote tribe. However, the expedition is hijacked by a crazed hunter who plans to use them as bait to catch a gigantic killer snake. Adventure, starring Jennifer Lopez, Jon Voight, Ice Cube, Eric Stoltz and Jonathan Hyde.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon.

programme.desc: A decade after they joined forces, survivors Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock have become experts in identifying and disposing assorted zombies. They set up their new home in the abandoned White House, but after Little Rock heads to Graceland, the team attempts to save her from a group of super zombies. Director Ruben Fleischer's comedy horror sequel, starring Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg and Emma Stone.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An unambitious 29-year-old man recently dumped and trapped in the job from hell decides to get his life back on track. Unfortunately, he has to put his plans on hold when zombies rise from their graves and stalk the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, starring Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Kate Ashfield, Dylan Moran, Lucy Davis, Bill Nighy and Penelope Wilton.

However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

A 5.5 magnitude earthquake rocks the city, causing structural failures in the basement that expose an old bank vault and a copy of the Naturom Demonto. Horror, starring Alyssa Sutherland.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

Salons, courses historiques et événements populaires, l'émission est partout là où s'écrit la passion automobile. Sur sa base d'essai située sur le très secret circuit de Mortefontaine, Automoto teste les voitures de sport et met à l'épreuve toutes les nouveautés, sans concession ! Derrière le volant, vous retrouverez les pilotes historiques de l'émission comme Anthony Beltoise ou Bruce Jouanny, rejoints la saison dernière par Sarah Bovy. Côté motos, les habitués d'Automoto pourront également retrouver Bader Benlekehal. En parallèle, l'émission continuera de proposer une large diversité de sujets et de reportages : rubrique pratique, essais, comparatifs, sports mécaniques, vintage...

Au programme : les résumés de 2 affiches, la nouvelle rubrique le Multiplex consacrée aux 4 rencontres du samedi soir, des reportages, des coulisses, des portraits et des interviews exclusives pour une couverture élargie et plus immersive de la Ligue 1. programme.title: 66 minutes
programme.desc:
Burger, toujours moins cher ?
C’est l’un des plats préférés des Français. Et l’un des plus économiques. Bien que réputé calorique, le burger a particulièrement la cote en cette période où le pouvoir d’achat est en berne. Il séduit aussi bien les étudiants au budget serré que les jeunes actifs ou encore les familles. Ces derniers mois certains restaurateurs multiplient les initiatives pour faire baisser encore l’addition en proposant des burgers anti-crise. Une façon également de remplir leurs salles alors que les Français vont de moins en moins au restaurant. Et les grandes enseignes de fast food ont également suivi la tendance. Elles proposent toutes désormais, en plus de leurs grands classiques, des menus à 5 euros en moyenne. Vous découvrirez les secrets de ces sandwichs à petit prix. 

Halloween : fête américaine, business en France 
Un bonbon ou un sort ! Qui n’a jamais entendu cette formule en ouvrant sa porte le soir d’Halloween ? Cette fête typiquement américaine est devenue depuis quelques années l’une des préférées des Français. Dimanche prochain, les enfants ne dérogeront pas à la tradition. Pour le plus grand bonheur des marques et des magasins : décorations, déguisements, certaines boutiques réalisent jusqu’à 20 % de leur chiffre d’affaires annuels sur cette période. Les parcs d’attractions, qui pour la plupart se mettent également aux couleurs d’Halloween, réalisent des records d’affluence à cette occasion.

Chasse aux squatteurs : le compte à rebours est lancé ! 
Dimanche 1er novembre débutera la trêve hivernale qui interdit les expulsions locatives. Depuis quelques semaines, de nombreux petits propriétaires sont engagés dans une course contre la montre. Objectif : tenter de déloger, avant qu’il ne soit trop tard, les squatteurs ou mauvais payeurs qui occupent illégalement leur appartement. Pour ces propriétaires, ce logement représente souvent les économies d’une vie. Et vous verrez comment certains sont contraints de vivre au camping ou de payer une location faute de pouvoir récupérer leur bien. Alors que faire quand le locataire ne paye plus ou a fait changer les serrures ? Saisir les tribunaux en urgence ? Ou avoir recours à d’autres moyens pas toujours légaux ?

Les nouveaux défis du roi du discount
C’est un concept inédit dans lequel vient de se lancer Lidl. Le numéro 1 du discount en France a ouvert cette semaine, près de Marseille, un magasin éphémère entièrement dédié à sa gamme d’outils de bricolage et de jardinage à petits prix. 1500 mètres carrés de surface, près de 500 références en rayon, et des clients qui se sont levés tôt pour profiter de bonnes affaires. En parallèle, Lidl multiplie, ces derniers mois, les initiatives : ouvertures de magasins de déstockage et modernisation de ses supermarchés traditionnels. Le discounter allemand a décidé de frapper fort après plusieurs années de turbulences.

programme.title: 66 minutes : grand format
programme.sub-title: Anne-Sophie Pic, cheffe de cœur des Français
programme.desc: Elle est la cheffe préférée des Français et la femme la plus étoilée au monde, avec 11 macarons au Guide Michelin. Anne-Sophie Pic nous a ouvert ses portes pour une immersion exceptionnelle au cœur de son univers. Alors que son restaurant familial de Valence s’apprête à fêter ses 90 ans, vous découvrirez son combat pour continuer à faire vivre cette institution ouverte par son grand-père en 1936. Autodidacte, la cheffe, qui ne se destinait pas à la cuisine, a pourtant su atteindre l’excellence en regagnant, en 2007, les trois étoiles qu’elle n’a jamais perdues depuis. Un savoir-faire qu’elle s’attache à transmettre avec bienveillance à ses équipes, loin des clichés du monde de la restauration. En cuisine, dans son laboratoire, ou aux côtés de son mari David, avec qui elle travaille au quotidien, portrait d’une cheffe hors norme.

programme.title: Zone interdite
programme.sub-title: Guerre des voisins : jusqu’où sont-ils prêts à aller ?
programme.desc:
Un chien qui aboie. Une boîte à colis mal placée. Un héritage mal partagé. Il suffit parfois d'un rien pour transformer un voisin en ennemi juré. Et une fois les hostilités déclarées, plus personne ne semble prêt au moindre compromis.
En 2023, les conciliateurs de justice ont traité près de 190 000 affaires de conflits de voisinage. Derrière ces querelles parfois dérisoires : des vies fracturées, des milliers d'euros engloutis et dans les cas les plus extrêmes… la violence.
Pendant plusieurs mois, Zone Interdite s'est immergée au cœur de quatre guerres de voisinage.
À Saint-Jean-le-Thomas (Manche), Manon, boulangère, est en guerre avec son voisin médecin pour une allée séparant leurs bâtiments. Insultes, menaces, provocations… quelques mètres de bitume suffisent à déclencher une guerre sans merci.
À Arignac (Ariège) à la mort de leurs parents, Maria et son frère héritent ensemble de la maison familiale. Sur le papier, tout semblait simple. Très vite, la fratrie vole en éclats : accès contestés, limites floues, procédures judiciaires… peuvent-ils encore faire la paix ?
Près d’Aix-en-Provence (Bouches-du-Rhône), pour Véronique, tout commence par une plainte : ses chiens aboient trop. La situation dérape violemment. Coups de feu, un chat tué, un chien blessé. Zone Interdite a obtenu l'autorisation exceptionnelle de filmer le procès.
À Thury-Harcourt (Calvados), Sébastien et Jean-Charles, amis et voisins de commerce depuis dix ans, ne se parlent plus. En cause, une boîte à colis installée sans accord sur leur parking commun. Finiront-ils devant un juge ?
Zone Interdite a enquêté sur ces guerres du quotidien pour comprendre comment on passe d'un simple « bonjour » à une guerre ouverte et jusqu'où certains sont prêts à aller pour défendre leur territoire….

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: Amsterdam : tensions sur le quartier rouge
programme.desc:
L'alcool, le sexe, la drogue : pendant des décennies, la capitale néerlandaise a tout assumé. Et en a tiré profit. Amsterdam est devenue la première destination européenne des enterrements de vie de garçon, envahie par des millions de fêtards. Mais aujourd’hui, ses 90 000 habitants n’en peuvent plus : canaux pollués, rues jonchées de déchets et touristes qui urinent dans les poubelles leur font vivre un enfer. Els Iping, ancienne élue locale, a compilé les preuves, traîné la mairie devant les tribunaux et gagné. Son collectif baptisé « Arrêtons cette folie », a forcé les autorités à agir. La méthode est choc : une taxe de séjour à 33 % du prix de la nuit (la plus élevée au monde), l’interdiction des navires de croisière, et surtout la fin des Airbnb dans le centre historique. D'ici 2026, la municipalité aura investi 270 millions d'euros pour tenter d’en finir avec un tourisme jugé « bas de gamme ».
Le célèbre Quartier Rouge concentre à lui seul tous les excès. Haut lieu de la prostitution : ses 250 vitrines, ses bars et ses coffee shops représentent 1 milliard d'euros de revenus annuels. La mairie veut aujourd'hui déplacer les 3 000 travailleuses du sexe dans un bâtiment en périphérie : l’« Erotic Center ». Une décision qui provoque la colère des prostituées, mais aussi des propriétaires des fameuses vitrines. Des hommes d’affaires, comme Pim van Burkn qui en détient une quarantaine, elles lui rapportent autour de 2 millions d'euros par an et il n’est pas prêt à laisser filer son pactole.
Sur le terrain, le brigadier Lex Wind patrouille chaque nuit dans ce quartier chaud qui enregistre le record d'arrestations du pays. Guidé par plus de 1 300 caméras, il délivre chaque week-end une cinquantaine de bannissements, les fautifs doivent quitter les lieux parfois pour plusieurs mois. Nos équipes ont suivi la Team Bert, une brigade de policiers en civil qui se fondent dans la foule pour prendre dealers et délinquants en flagrant délit. 
Les célèbres coffee shops vivent eux aussi une révolution silencieuse. La mairie en a fermé plus de la moitié en vingt ans. Ceux qui restent se transforment peu à peu en boutiques de luxe et on achète son cannabis dans une ambiance de marbres et de dorures. À 100 kilomètres d'Amsterdam, le gouvernement expérimente la première production légale et traçable de cannabis aux Pays-Bas. Une usine ultra-sécurisée qui produit 150 à 200 kilos par semaine. Paradoxe absolu : pas un gramme de cette herbe ne sera vendu à Amsterdam car les coffee shops continuent de se fournir illégalement.

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.desc:
Deuxième ville d’Allemagne, Hambourg attire 15 millions de touristes par an. Surnommée la Venise du Nord, avec ses canaux bordés de demeures luxueuses et son port, l’un des plus modernes du monde, Hambourg est aussi célèbre pour ses quartiers sulfureux, son sens de la fête et ses personnalités locales hors norme.

Issu de l’une des familles les plus riches d’Allemagne, Frank Otto est un milliardaire atypique. Avec ses cheveux longs, son look de star hollywoodienne, il aime, à 62 ans, s’afficher aux côtés de jeunes mannequins. Depuis son sublime hôtel particulier (1 000 m²) au cœur de la ville, il dirige un groupe de médias, mais c’est aussi un touche-à-tout qui a investi dans l’art, la musique et même le football. Il a notamment sauvé de la faillite le FC Sankt Pauli, un club de football qui joue en deuxième division et qui n’a jamais rien gagné de son histoire, mais dont tous les matchs se jouent à guichets fermés. C’est le seul club au monde dont les statuts spécifient qu’il est antiraciste, antihomophobe, antifasciste. Il revendique 11 millions de supporters à travers le monde, dont 30 % de femmes. L’emblème du club : un drapeau pirate avec une tête de mort sur fond noir.
Sven, un ex-punk, est le régisseur du club ; nous le suivons un jour de match. Nous découvrons aussi comment ce club très riche soutient la vie du quartier et la solidarité entre ses habitants, là où le non-conformisme est la règle.

Car Sankt Pauli est un quartier qui ne ressemble à aucun autre. Traversé par la sulfureuse avenue Reeperbahn, considérée comme l’avenue de tous les péchés, il abrite de nombreux lieux de fête et même des maisons closes (légales en Allemagne), concentrées dans la rue Herbertstraße, interdite aux femmes non prostituées. Nous avons rencontré Thorsten Eitner, le gérant du Pink Palace, un établissement de 5 étages avec 54 chambres, louées 100 euros par jour à des professionnelles.
Dans le quartier, il y a aussi un cabaret transformiste très célèbre, l'Olivia Show Club, du nom d'Olivia Jones, 52 ans, 2,07 mètres, de son véritable nom Oliver Knöbel, la star des drag-queens en Allemagne. Personnalité haute en couleur, Olivia a même été invitée au Parlement allemand en tant qu’ambassadrice des valeurs de tolérance et d’ouverture de Hambourg.

Le week-end, à Sankt Pauli, c’est la fête 24 heures sur 24, avec parfois les inévitables débordements (bagarres, trafics, alcool). Nos équipes ont pu suivre nuit et jour l’une des brigades du commissariat de la Reeperbahn, qui gère les problèmes liés aux milliers de fêtards qui débarquent dans le quartier.

programme.title: Enquête exclusive
programme.sub-title: Brésil, le pays des fermiers milliardaires
programme.desc: Loin des plages de Rio, un nouvel empire émerge au cœur du Brésil avec à sa tête des fermiers millionnaires. Autrefois considérées comme des terres arides et hostiles, les immenses plaines du centre-ouest brésilien sont devenues l’eldorado de l’agrobusiness. \r\nEn une décennie, le boom des exportations de soja et de bovins a fait émerger de colossales fortunes, une caste d’ultra-riches dont le pouvoir ne cesse de croître. Leur capitale, Goiânia, 2 millions d’habitants, est surnommée le « Dubaï brésilien ». Le luxe s’y affiche sans complexe : les gratte-ciels de prestige sont dotés de piscines privées à chaque étage et d’ascenseurs pour voiture permettant de se garer directement sur sa terrasse. Une Porsche s’y vend chaque jour, et les listes d'attente pour une montre Rolex s'étendent sur quatre ans. Les mariages fastueux entre enfants de grands propriétaires terriens atteignent des millions d'euros et sont des démonstrations de puissance autant que des événements mondains.\r\nLes magnats de l’agrobusiness jouent à dessein la carte du glamour en sponsorisant des concours de miss, des feuilletons télévisés et des groupes de musique country tout à la gloire de leurs valeurs conservatrices. Car derrière les paillettes se cache une redoutable machine politique. Le puissant lobby de ces fermiers millionnaires prône la libéralisation des armes, l’usage massif de pesticides et l’opposition farouche à la protection de l'Amazonie. Et ils comptent bien peser sur l’élection présidentielle en cours en apportant leur soutien à l’ultra-conservateur Flavio Bolsonaro, fils aîné de l’ancien président d’extrême droite Jair Bolsonaro, face à Lula da Silva, le président de gauche sortant.

programme.sub-title: S9 E16 - Pas de fumée sans feu
programme.desc: Après une intervention sur un incendie qui tourne à l'émeute, Chimney doit défendre les décisions de la 118 devant une commission d'enquête. Buck soutient ses coéquipiers en coulisses en attendant de savoir s'il pourra réintégrer la caserne.

Buck est confronté à son passé lors d'une intervention liée à une urgence électrique et à un don précieux qu'il a fait à un ami quatre ans plus tôt. Maddie apprend à gérer ses relations professionnelles depuis qu'elle est devenue superviseuse...

Après avoir été grièvement blessée lors d'une fusillade, Athena lutte pour sa survie tandis que la 118 et ses proches se mobilisent à l'hôpital. L'instigateur du réseau de trafic est déterminé à réduire Athena au silence et quiconque se mettra en travers de son chemin...

Les membres de l’unité 118 travaillent une fois de plus pendant la nuit la plus effrayante de l'année et ne peuvent pas profiter de la fête. Les décorations d'Halloween de Buck sont encore plus terrifiantes qu’il ne l’avait imaginé.

Les membres de l’unité 118 travaillent une fois de plus pendant la nuit la plus effrayante de l'année et ne peuvent pas profiter de la fête. Les décorations d'Halloween de Buck sont encore plus terrifiantes qu’il ne l’avait imaginé.

D’anciennes blessures se réveillent lorsque les membres de la 118 se précipitent pour venir en aide à un homme confronté à une menace de divorce. Un petit garçon tombe dans un tuyau d’évacuation et s’y retrouve coincé. La 118 doit dépasser ses compétences habituelles pour le sauver.

Athena se voit confier une nouvelle recrue, le stagiaire Matthew Sparks, qui la fait douter de ses capacités. Le chef Simmons demande à Bobby d’assister la star Brad Torrance sur le tournage de la série « Cœurs de feu », dont la production est un généreux donateur pour la caserne.

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent
programme.desc: Pour cette nouvelle soirée d'auditions, Marianne James, Éric Antoine, Hélène Ségara et Sugar Sammy vont devoir s'attendre à tout… et surtout à de l'inattendu !\r\nLes candidats peuvent débarquer avec un talent parfaitement maîtrisé… ou une idée que personne n'avait vue venir. Le résultat ? Des numéros qui bluffent, qui font rire, qui impressionnent et parfois qui laissent le jury franchement perplexe ! La soirée risque une nouvelle fois de réserver quelques surprises.\r\nCar sur cette scène, personne n'est venu faire de la figuration : performances XXL, idées complètement folles, prises de risques… les talents vont devoir tout donner pour décrocher leur place pour la suite de l'aventure. Et pourquoi pas aller jusqu'à faire retentir le fameux Golden Buzzer ?

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent, ça continue
programme.desc: Juju Fitcats est aux commandes de l’after-show, un rendez-vous fun et toujours surprenant. Au programme : une immersion totale dans les coulisses, les réactions à chaud des candidats, des confidences inédites, les interviews exclusives du jury, des images jamais vues… Rien n’échappe à Juju, qui capte tout avec son ton ultra connecté !

programme.title: Le mensonge
programme.desc: Dix ans après, Lucas peine à construire sa vie. Meurtri, mais toujours combatif, son grand-père, Claude Arbona, parvient à se faire réélire maire.

programme.title: Le mensonge
programme.desc: Après mûre réflexion, Lucas, devenu papa, doute de plus en plus de ses souvenirs et des accusations de viol proférées enfant, tandis que Claude est condamné par la justice.

programme.title: Maghreb-Orient Express
programme.sub-title: Kader Attou, Soufiane Guerrab, Nadia Henni-Moulaï, Serge Najjar

programme.title: Vroum
programme.desc: Laurent se rend à Saint-André-de-l'Eure, pour échanger avec un père et un fils fan de Renault. Puis direction Sylvains-les-Moulins avec Michel, qui monte à bord d'une Porsche de compétition.

programme.title: Partir autrement entre amis
programme.sub-title: Agadir, Maroc (Pier-Luc Funk et Antoine Pilon)
programme.desc: Comédiens et amis de longue date, Pier-Luc Funk et Antoine Pilon partent à l'aventure dans la région d'Agadir. Tout est prétexte à compétition pour eux.

programme.title: Le point
programme.desc: Pendant un an, immersion dans la vie de cinq jeunes agriculteurs, passionnés et résilients. De leur diplôme à la concrétisation de leurs défis professionnels, la réalité est souvent plus difficile que ce qu'ils avaient imaginé. Lors d'un concours de beauté pour vaches, plus d'une centaine d'éleveurs passionnés participent à la finale provinciale des expositions agricoles pour vaches laitières.

programme.title: Mission info
programme.desc: Myriam revient sur les revendications des lycéens : infrastructures dégradées, emplois du temps trop chargés, enseignants non remplacés... Élise rencontre des lycéens qui préparent leurs pancartes et organisent des blocages. Raphäl s'est penché sur les images décalées des manifestations qui circulent sur internet.

programme.title: Wari
programme.sub-title: Sécheresse et faim : le Nord ivoirien mise sur l'agroforesterie
programme.desc: Sécheresse et faim : le Nord ivoirien mise sur l'agroforesterie Dans le nord de la Côte d'Ivoire, la sécheresse et les pluies imprévisibles épuisent les sols et menacent les récoltes. D'ici 2080, près d'un quart des terres cultivables pourraient être exposées à la sécheresse. Face à cette urgence, des villages misent sur l'agroforesterie et une cuisine plus nutritive.

programme.title: Cousu
programme.desc: Au Danemark, certaines marques se distinguent par leur durabilité et leur mordant. Karine Vanasse rencontre des designers danois qui défient les règles de la mode.

programme.title: Echappées belles
programme.sub-title: Côtes d'Armor, la Bretagne en action
programme.desc: Les Côtes d'Armor sont un territoire baigné par la Manche et l'Atlantique, sculpté par les vents et façonné par une relation viscérale à la mer. Au fil de ses rencontres, Ismaël Khelifa va découvrir que ce lien à l'océan n'est pas qu'économique ou géographique. Il est culturel, spirituel, presque mythique.

programme.title: Suisse en scène
programme.desc: De "La Salamandre" à la série "H", en passant par la Comédie-Française, Jean-Luc Bideau s'est imposé en comédien populaire et exigeant : présence imposante, geste ample, voix puissante, phrasé volontiers ironique, regard aussi malicieux que tendre. En un mot, incontournable.

programme.title: Gotha
programme.sub-title: Le prince Aymeric s'essaye à la course automobile
programme.desc: A 20 ans, le prince Aymeric se lance dans une nouvelle aventure : il devient pilote automobile et prend le départ de sa première course officielle. Direction ensuite l'Italie, à la découverte de Seborga, une mystérieuse micro-principauté qui revendique son indépendance. Exploration des coulisses très secrètes du 21 juillet avec l'homme qui orchestre le défilé national et découverte du protocole royal.

programme.title: Rassemblance
programme.desc: Ibrahim, porteur de trisomie 21, travaille comme serveur au restaurant inclusif "Le Reflet". Formé à l'hôtellerie, il a construit un parcours d'autonomie.

programme.title: Hep taxi !
programme.desc: Avec une Palme d'or à Cannes, un César du meilleur espoir et 17 autres prix pour "La vie d'Adèle" d'Abdellatif Kechiche, Adèle Exarchopoulos a connu en 2013, la consécration suprême et une ascension fulgurante. Depuis, elle tourne dans le monde entier. De passage à Bruxelles pour défendre son dix-huitième film, "Le fidèle" de Michaël Roskam, l'actrice s'est confiée sans réserve à Jérôme Colin.

programme.title: Au bout de l'enquête, la fin du crime parfait ?

Un digest aussi enlevé qu'éclectique qui propose des reportages et des rencontres avec ceux qui sont à l'affiche. Ici, pas de chapelles ni de dogmes, uniquement de l'appétit, de la curiosité et du partage.

programme.title: Ripoux 3
programme.desc: Un ancien policier perd un sac plein de billets, propriété de la mafia chinoise. Il se retrouve pourchassé par les truands, la police et ses anciens amis.

programme.title: Ripoux contre Ripoux
programme.desc: Deux inspecteurs corrompus de Montmartre, dénoncés par une commerçante du quartier, sont mis à pied et remplacés par deux confrères encore plus véreux.

programme.title: Meurtres à...
programme.desc: Une jeune femme, lieutenant de gendarmerie, tente d'élucider un meurtre sordide, duquel son propre frère, atteint de trisomie 21, est accusé.

programme.title: Caméra café
programme.desc: Caméra café nous plonge de manière insolite dans le monde implacable de l'entreprise. Confidences, rumeurs, conflits, coups de gueule ou coups de cœur, il se passe toujours quelque chose devant la machine à café !

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Holmes et Watson se retrouvent impliqués dans le conflit interne au groupe activiste "Everyone", quand l'un des membres les plus importants est tué.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Un démystificateur est retrouvé assassiné dans sa voiture. Les recherches du détective le mènent sur la trace d'un homme, qui a cherché a pirater Internet.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Holmes et Watson enquêtent sur le meurtre d'un archéologue, qui semble avoir été tué après avoir déterré un lot de jeux vidéo datant des années 80.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Holmes et Watson sont sur la piste d'un pirate informatique, soupçonné de trois meurtres, dont celui d'un millionnaire russe en visite à New York.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes accepte de travailler avec la brigade des stupéfiants pour faire tomber un gang de motards qui revend de la drogue : la mission tourne mal.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Après la mort d'une vieille dame fortunée, poussée d'un balcon, Sherlock s'intéresse à une affaire immobilière complexe. Par ailleurs, Watson découvre la liaison de Gregson.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Un homme meurt fauché par un camion. Un témoignage évoquant un animal incandescent pousse Holmes et Watson à s'intéresser à des expérimentations controversées.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.sub-title: Aux grands maux les grands remèdes
programme.desc: Sherlock et Joan trouvent une bombe à leur domicile, puis apprennent que le chef de la sécurité de Morland a été agressé tout près de chez eux.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Un homme prend une vingtaine d'otages, dont Joan, afin de forcer Sherlock à enquêter sur le meurtre de son fils, avant la prescription de l'affaire.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Le commentateur d'une compétition "e-sport" a disparu. Holmes et Watson suivent sa piste et finissent par découvrir son cadavre : des joueurs sont suspectés.

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Derrière des manières décalées, le capitaine Marleau a l'instinct du chasseur. Un jour, le corps d'une femme assassinée est retrouvé dans l'entreprise de transports de Philippe Muir. Tout semble jouer en sa défaveur. En effet, ce n'est pas la première femme qui meurt dans son entourage proche...

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.sub-title: La cité des âmes en peine
programme.desc: Une connaissance de Marleau est accusée de meurtre. La capitaine doit composer avec un policier renommé saisi par le procureur, qui enquête à charge.

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Un homme a été assassiné pendant le mariage de sa fille. Marleau s'intéresse à l'emploi du temps d'un chanteur qu'elle admire, présent à la cérémonie.

programme.title: A Suivre avec Loïc de La Mornais

A Suivre avec Loïc de La Mornais
Dr Cath & Ludo au bout du monde
programme.desc: Invités dans son palais par la Princesse Bhavna, le Dr Cath et Ludovic Daxhelet visitent le Rajasthan, royaume des Maharajas et des palais somptueux.

programme.title: Dr Cath : Mission adoption
programme.desc: Fabrice et Cath prennent des nouvelles de Zebra, magnifique chien de 15 ans saisi l'année passée pour cas de maltraitance. Ils s'occupent également de cobayes saisis par le refuge.

programme.title: Dr Cath : Mission adoption
programme.desc: Cette année encore, Dr Cath vient prêter main forte aux équipes de deux refuges pour animaux abandonnés ou saisis. Avec elle, assistez à de belles rencontres qui changeront la vie des petites pensionnaires des refuges. Objectif : tout donner à ces animaux qui le méritent et qui ont tout à partager.

programme.title: Dr Cath : Mission adoption
